text:
Hend maked, jays, broad, and compreffed; mouth fur
silhed with beard; pape and throat wide; lips thick;
jaws dentated; tongue thick, (mouch, and very thort;
eye final); gil-membrane furnished hair from four
to factors rays; body elongated, compreffed, facile, covered with vidl lines; lateral line near the
back; it be fifty of the pectoral fins, or of the der-
fal fin, finy, and dentated backwax.
